categories.main_business_segments: Unisplendour Corporation Limited (Unis) primarily operates in the new generation information and communication technology (ICT) sector, focusing on cloud computing infrastructure and intelligent industry application services. Its main business segments include network equipment (switches, routers, WLAN, IoT, SDN, 5G small cells, PON), servers (general, AI, blade, edge), storage products (all-flash, hybrid, distributed storage), cloud computing and services (virtualization, cloud OS, hyper-converged infrastructure, big data platforms), network security products and services, and intelligent terminals (commercial laptops, desktops, smart screens). The company also provides one-stop digital solutions for various industries and full lifecycle services including design, software development, system integration, and operation and maintenance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as cloud-native distributed cloud architecture, AI large models (AIGC), silicon photonics for data center switches, liquid cooling solutions for energy efficiency, and intelligent operation platforms. It develops proprietary software platforms like Comware, ADNET, U-Center, CloudOS, ONEStor, BIOS, and BMC, and integrates hardware and software innovations in networking, computing, storage, security, and cloud services. The company emphasizes R&D with over 40% of employees in research roles and invests heavily in AI, 5G, IPv6+, edge computing, and green ICT infrastructure.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Unis serves a broad range of customers including government agencies, telecom operators, internet companies, financial institutions, education, healthcare, agriculture, transportation, energy, and manufacturing sectors. It supports major national projects such as backbone networks for the three major Chinese telecom operators, smart city initiatives, digital government clouds, financial digital transformation for leading banks and insurance companies, and digital infrastructure for airports, railways, and highways. The company also caters to over 10,000 enterprises including numerous Fortune 500 and central state-owned enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with over 96% of revenue generated domestically. It has an extensive sales and service network across China with more than 40 offices and over 5,000 sales personnel. Internationally, Unis has established 17 overseas branches and over 2,100 certified partners across Asia, Europe, Africa, and Latin America, actively expanding its presence in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Central Asia, and developed markets in Europe and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Unis operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the ICT supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of ICT hardware and software products. It provides end-to-end solutions including infrastructure products, cloud services, and digital transformation services, positioning itself as a comprehensive ICT solutions provider rather than a raw material supplier or pure distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven growth centered around the 'cloud-network-security-computing-storage-terminal' full-stack ICT architecture. It prioritizes R&D in AI large models (AIGC), heterogeneous computing platforms, high-performance networking (including 400G/800G silicon photonics), cloud-native distributed cloud, intelligent security, and green ICT technologies like liquid cooling. Unis aims to lead in AI for industry applications, cloud intelligence, and digital infrastructure modernization, with continuous investment in R&D exceeding 7% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: Unis generates revenue primarily through product sales of ICT hardware including network devices, servers, storage, and intelligent terminals. It also earns from cloud computing services, software solutions, system integration, and ongoing operation and maintenance services. The company’s revenue streams include direct sales, distribution channels, and long-term service contracts with government, enterprise, and telecom customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Unis is a leading player in China’s ICT infrastructure market, holding top market shares in Ethernet switches, enterprise routers, WLAN, X86 servers, GPU servers, blade servers, security hardware, and hyper-converged infrastructure. It ranks consistently among the top two in most product categories domestically. Its main competitors include other major Chinese ICT firms and global vendors in networking, computing, and cloud services. Unis leverages its comprehensive product portfolio, strong R&D, and extensive customer base to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Unis reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 77.3 billion, representing a 4.39% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 2.1 billion. The company’s total assets reached RMB 87.3 billion, up 17.82% from the previous year, with net assets of RMB 33.9 billion. R&D investment was RMB 5.64 billion, accounting for 7.3% of revenue. The company shows steady growth in revenue and market share, with expanding domestic and international business.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Unis emphasizes its comprehensive full-stack ICT infrastructure capabilities, integrating cloud, network, security, computing, storage, and intelligent terminals to provide one-stop digital transformation solutions. Its proprietary technologies, such as AI large models, silicon photonics switches, and liquid cooling, differentiate it in performance, energy efficiency, and innovation. The company’s deep industry expertise, extensive customer base, and strong R&D enable tailored solutions for diverse sectors, supporting customers’ digital and intelligent upgrades with high-quality, scalable, and secure ICT products and services.
